title: Roti

ingredientGroups.title: Ingredients
items: 400 g atta, including 50 g reserved for dusting

steps: Add 350 g atta, oil, salt, butter or ghee and boiling water to a bowl. Mix with a spoon for 1 minute while hot.
Dust the worktop with some reserved flour and knead the dough for 5 minutes. Cover with a bowl and rest for 5–10 minutes.
Knead 30 seconds more and divide into 12 pieces. Roll into balls, press into discs, dip in flour and keep covered.
Roll each disc slightly, dust both sides with flour, then roll to full roti size.
Heat a tawa over medium heat. Cook each roti for 30 seconds, flip for 20 seconds, then flip again for 10 seconds. Set aside and repeat.
